fusions.name: Yoked Pair
fusions.desc: Throws a yoke that deals 12 damage and stuns the target for 1 second, then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage.

fusions.name: Penned With the Herd
fusions.desc: Closes a pen around you that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaves each [Hindered] for 5 seconds. Your party deals 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Drover's Gate
fusions.desc: Lays a grid of bars 6 tiles long for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it, and anything that touches it moves 25% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Branded Stock
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 6. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
